reasons.plausibility: The proposed Zr doping approach aligns with known effects of solute additions on grain-boundary chemistry and precipitation, though the optimal Zr level and actual efficacy remain uncertain.
reasons.testability: The side-by-side irradiation experiment with clear microstructural, compositional, and mechanical evaluations can directly confirm or refute the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: Refining nanocrystalline W-based alloys via minor dopants to suppress precipitates and maintain properties is highly relevant and practically appealing for fusion applications.
